channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Fred VanVleet | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Fred VanVleet from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Steven Adams, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“It's growing every day. I feel like we can be even closer as a coach-player. Somebody that I always can lean on throughout a game and vice versa. We need to continue to keep building that. Also having Fred (VanVleet) and Steven (Adams) back is going to be good for all of us, being in these leadership positions and having younger guys on the team that look up to us. It's a group effort in everything we do, leadership, scoring, defending, everything is a group effort.”

Kevin Durant on Steven Adams, Fred VanVleet, Sep 24, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
NBA Courtside:Joe Johnson says if he’s the Houston Rockets I’m taking that gamble on Russel Westbrookteaming back up with Kevin Durant:

“I’m taking that gamble because look, think about this. Even if Fred VanVleet, I’m sure he will start the season, but damn, he just come off of ACL surgery. Y’all going to run him in the ground for 82 game. And what he going to be able to get you in the postseason? Nothing. So, you got to have some depth at that point guard position. Guys who know how to play, guys who know and understand the game and who can make the game easy for guys around him. So, I always think, bro, and when you look at him because he up in age, he always in great damn shape. And for me, y’all know me, bro. I’m a guy who loves a guy in great shape. You’re in great shape. You can play with me any day.”

Kevin Durant on Fred VanVleet, Aug 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet’s future:

“I think both sides want to be here & want him here… He’s a huge part of our growth. Love everything he’s done. Perfect combo of on & off ball for our guards & young guys to grow. I’d love to have him back, & I think the feeling’s mutual.”

Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet, May 5, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Houston's defensive scheme vs Draymond Green:

“They're putting VanVleet on him for a reason. They're trying to take away Draymond's playmaking and take him out of our offensive scheme as best they can. This is not an easy series for Dray.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Fred VanVleet, Apr 28, 2025. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on Houston's defensive scheme vs Draymond Green:

“They're putting VanVleet on him for a reason. They're trying to take away Draymond's playmakingand take him out of our offensive scheme as best they can. This is not an easy series for Dray.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Fred VanVleet, Apr 28, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dillon Brooks, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Warriors coach Steve Kerr on the Rockets:

“Athleticism. Defense. They have an identity. Ime's done a great job establishing who they are. They've got a lot of great athletes, several years in a row in the lottery. They've put together a really good roster, good free agent signings with VanVleet and Brooks. Formidable team, for sure.”

Steve Kerr on Dillon Brooks, Fred VanVleet, Apr 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Jabari Smith on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“He talks a lot. Always honest, don't let anything pass … whatever coach is saying, whatever coach not saying, [VanVleet is] saying. He’s just a great person [to] learn from [and] he's a great locker room guy. Jokes around a lot, very likable. I'm pretty sure all the teammates like him … you know, what I'm saying? Real awesome. Just a good dude.”

Jabari Smith on Fred VanVleet, Feb 1, 2024. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Ime Udoka on the elbow Fred VanVleet took early in the game:

“Very similar to the call they called on Dillon. Fred got elbowed too. One goes one way and one goes the other. I can see it from the opposite end and three refs can't see it right there.”

Ime Udoka on Fred VanVleet, Dec 18, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Gradey Dick on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
The team visited Dick’s school.

“With my school I remember, Wichita State when Fred [VanVleet] was there,”

Gradey Dick on Fred VanVleet, Jul 29, 2023. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Bobby Webster on Fred VanVleet declining his player option for next season:

“We’re obviously on good terms with Fred, spoke to him yesterday. I think that was expected. Wasn’t unexpected.”

Bobby Webster on Fred VanVleet, Jun 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
On Thursday night VanVleet was fined $30,000 by the NBA for his public criticism of the officiating.

“Idon’t know if you guys have seen Fred VanVleet’s interview, (but) that’s all I’m gonna say,”

Marcus Smart on Fred VanVleet, Mar 11, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Kyrie on VanVleet:

“I love going against Fred. I watch him a lot, he watches me a lot. Throughout the game talking back and forth a little bit. He hits a 3 in transition right in my face and he’s like ‘let’s go’. I have so much respect for Fred. He’s a winner. He’s a champion.”

Kyrie Irving on Fred VanVleet, Dec 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Michael Scotto:DeMar DeRozan on Fred VanVleet being an All-Star:

“I feel like a proud father right now. I remember going to his G League games every chance I got. To see him with an All-Star jersey, being a father, it makes me feel old, but at the same time, as a friend, I'm most proud.”

DeMar DeRozan on Fred VanVleet, Feb 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Bulls coach Billy Donovan on Fred VanVleet:

“I've always had a lot of respect for him as a player... One thing about him is he's always had great poise. The moment's never too big for him. He always makes big plays, timely plays.”

Billy Donovan on Fred VanVleet, Feb 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Chauncey Billups on Fred VanVleet:

“He’s so under appreciated. I think he’s maybe the most underrated player in the league. He can do it all. He’s a lockdown defender. He’s a big shot taker and maker. He’s tough as nails… I doing think he gets the credit he deserves.”

Chauncey Billups on Fred VanVleet, Jan 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Monty Williams on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Eric Koreen:Monty Williams on VanVleet:

“I’m not quite sure there’s anybody playing better than him in the East right now.”

Monty Williams on Fred VanVleet, Jan 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @ekoreen.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on VanVleet's all-star candidacy:

“We've gotta climb the standings some, I just think that's part of it, and if we do then he certainly will deserve it... We know what he brings. He brings winning and leadership, scoring, great defender. So he's gotta be in consideration.”

Nick Nurse on Fred VanVleet, Jan 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Lowry on Fred VanVleet:

“I think he took more of leadership role last year. I think he was starting to understand that at some point I wouldn't be there to be the leader or the guy,and he started to do a little more talking, coaching and mentoring... I think he's ready.”

Kyle Lowry on Fred VanVleet, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nick Nurse on assistant coach Fred VanVleet:

“He was great, really he was. He was really positive, motivating the guys. Really good. I thought his voice in timeouts and when guys were coming off the floor was a real positive influence. That was nice to see.”

Nick Nurse on Fred VanVleet, Apr 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Dwane Casey on Fred VanVleet:

“When he first came in for his workout I said who is that little kid over there on the sideline? He was a little small-ish and unassuming and I didn't really know who he was, but something stuck out. Fred has always had 'it'.”

Dwane Casey on Fred VanVleet, Mar 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Malachi Flynn on Kyle Lowry, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Flynn on Lowry and VanVleet:

“Just watching those 2 guys over the last couple years, what I take from them is just how hard they compete. Being undersized you've gotta find a way to make up for that, you've gotta be tough, and they both do that on the defensive end.”

Malachi Flynn on Kyle Lowry, Fred VanVleet, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Marc Gasol on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Marc Gasol on VanVleet:

“Fred has a heart, I don't know how it fits into his chest. He has a huge heart.”

Marc Gasol on Fred VanVleet, Jun 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Lowry on VanVleet:

“He's a tough little SOB, but that's why I love him and that's why he's going to be in this league a long time. He's going to do some special things in the league because of how tough he is, mentally and physically.”

Kyle Lowry on Fred VanVleet, Dec 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Fred VanVleet
item.description:
DeRozan on VanVleet:

“I don't know why I haven't heard it much but Fred should be 6th Man of The Year, or at least mentioned. The things he's been doing, leading our 2nd group as a 2nd-year player, it's incredible.”

DeMar DeRozan on Fred VanVleet, Apr 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
